about.name: Pavel Traktin
about.p.1: Experienced IT project leader with 10+ years of hands-on practice in building, launching, and maintaining web products — from e-commerce and marketplaces to travel services and integration-heavy solutions. I have a strong understanding of the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) and know how to set up delivery processes: requirements and task definition, prioritization, timeline and quality control, and collaboration with distributed teams. I combine product thinking with solid technical expertise (front-end, integrations, APIs, UX/UI), translating business goals into practical technical solutions and driving projects through release to stable production operation.

projects.h4.1: AeroHunt — a flight-deals discovery service with “real discounts” (website + Telegram channel + Telegram assistant bot)
projects.span.1: Project Founder & Lead, Front-End Development and Product Growth, Oct 2025 — present
projects.p.1: Built from scratch: the system surfaces genuinely good deals by comparing the current fare against a computed baseline (trend/average across nearby dates), continuously rechecks offers, updates prices, and removes outdated deals. Launched three delivery channels: a website with filters and live updates, a Telegram channel with topics by departure city, and a Telegram assistant bot that supports personal tasks and notifications. Implemented fast loading from generated monthly JSON feeds, client-side caching, and performance optimizations. Current scale: ~2,535 routes in the scan/recheck loop and ~7,903 active offers; full recheck cycle ~30–40 minutes.
projects.p.2: Tech & tools: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (vanilla), responsive UI, dynamic data loading/rendering, client-side caching and performance optimization; API integrations (Travelpayouts/Aviasales), Telegram Bot API (assistant + channel posting), generated JSON data feeds, admin panel, server infrastructure, backups and monitoring (in collaboration with the backend engineer).
projects.p.3: Worked at the intersection of QA, product logic, and UX improvements in a crypto trading product. Identified logical, interface, and workflow issues, translated them into clear requirements for developers and the UX designer, and validated implemented fixes.
projects.p.4: The product included a trading terminal, trader journal, asset operations, transfers between exchange and wallet accounts under broker-managed flows, deposit/withdrawal scenarios, and KYC-related processes. My main focus was improving clarity of user flows, reducing friction, and strengthening the overall usability of key trader-facing features.
projects.span.3: Project author and lead developer, development and management, 2011–2023
projects.p.5: Developed from scratch and later migrated from a proprietary engine to CS-Cart. Results: optimized price editing, automated online payments, introduced a small-wholesale storefront format, and reduced operator workload
projects.p.6: Implemented CS-Cart integrations with the bank and cloud-based fiscal register, developed a product-bundle configurator, and enabled automatic stock and price synchronization. Results: established a full online sales cycle with fiscal reporting and automated supply management.
projects.p.7: Developed a proprietary engine with integrated CDEK delivery, online payment confirmation workflow, and minimum order amount control.
projects.span.6: Business owner and head of development, 2007–2022
projects.p.8: Developed a proprietary engine and a point-of-sale and e-commerce management system with online receipts, integrated CDEK delivery, barcode generation, and fiscal receipt automation. Results: transformed the online store into a full-scale platform supporting both online and offline sales.
projects.p.9: Developed from scratch a shared product card system with multiple sellers, pricing grids, automated settlements, and offer validity control. Results: reduced manual work, improved data accuracy, and ensured transparent partner settlements.
projects.p.10: Implemented automation for tour creation, cruise route mapping on Google Maps, commission calculations, and contract generation. Results: fully automated document workflow and transparent settlements between agents and tour operators.
